# Spacer

> A Rust CLI, Tauri desktop app, and read-only terminal browser for organizing local Git projects into spaces and linked worktrees.

Spacer 0.0.1 is an alpha. Its hexagonal architecture separates presentation,
domain/application services, and data adapters. The versioned JSON registry owns
registrations and context; Git owns repository and worktree state. Finishing a
clean linked worktree retains its branch. Unregistering preserves files.
Workspace discovery uses SPACER_ROOT or the nearest ancestor workspace.

## Tutorials

- [Your first workspace](docs/tutorials/first-workspace.md): Create a repository and complete a worktree lifecycle.

- [Shell navigation](docs/how-to/shell-navigation.md): Wrappers, managed sessions, and Windows navigation.
- [Register an existing project](docs/how-to/existing-project.md): Register a primary repository without moving it.
- [Recovery](docs/how-to/recover-workspace.md): Legacy compatibility, conflicts, and partial failures.
- [Release verification](docs/how-to/verify-release.md): Native quality gates and archive smoke tests.
